panels.title: Nodes with PG drift
panels.description: 0 also when --pg-drift=false; check that ovnkube_controller_port_group_with_ports exists

targets.expr: count(count by (namespace, pod) (ovn_northd_nb_connection_status == 0 or ovn_northd_sb_connection_status == 0 or ovn_controller_southbound_database_connected == 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Nodes with drift
panels.description: NB Port_Groups with ports that are missing from the node's SB; these nodes need a recompute.

targets.expr: max by (node) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (ovnkube_controller_port_group_with_ports)) and on (node) (ovnk:pg_drift:missing_by_node > 0)
(ovnk:pg_drift:missing_by_node > 0) / on (node) clamp_min(max by (node) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (ovnkube_controller_port_group_with_ports)), 1)

panels.title: Full-recompute events
panels.description: Includes manual inc-engine/recompute and northd restarts

targets.expr: sum by (manager) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (rate(ovnkube_clustermanager_object_events_total[$interval]))) * 60
sum by (table, op) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (rate(ovnkube_controller_nb_db_updates_total{node=~"$node"}[$interval])))

panels.title: Max NB ACLs on a node
Max NB PortGroups on a node
ACLs per MNP rule
panels.description: Policy ACLs on secondary/UDN networks on the busiest node (which approximates MNP ACLs) per MultiNetworkPolicy rule

targets.expr: max(sum by (node) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (ovnkube_controller_nb_db_objects{table="ACL",owner_type="NetworkPolicy",network!="default"}))) / clamp_min(sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (ovnkube_clustermanager_multi_network_policy_rules)), 1)
sum by (managed_by) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (ovnkube_clustermanager_network_attachment_definitions))
sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (ovnkube_clustermanager_multi_network_policies))
sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (ovnkube_clustermanager_network_policies))
sum by (kind) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (ovnkube_clustermanager_user_defined_networks))
sum(max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (ovnkube_clustermanager_multi_network_policy_network_targets))
sum by (direction) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (ovnkube_clustermanager_multi_network_policy_rules))
sum by (direction) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (ovnkube_clustermanager_multi_network_policy_peers))

panels.title: SB/NB effectiveness
panels.description: SB Logical_Flows per NB ACL on each node

targets.expr: sum by (owner_type) (max without (instance, pod, endpoint, container, service) (ovnkube_controller_nb_db_objects{table="ACL",node=~"$node",network=~"$network"}))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, kind) (rate(ovnkube_controller_network_programming_duration_seconds_bucket[1h]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"}))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, kind) (rate(ovnkube_controller_network_programming_duration_seconds_bucket[1h]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"}))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(ovnkube_controller_network_programming_ovn_duration_seconds_bucket[1h]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"}))
sum by (kind) (rate(ovnkube_controller_network_programming_duration_seconds_count[$interval]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"}) * 60
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(ovnkube_controller_resource_add_latency_seconds_bucket[1h]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"}))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(ovnkube_controller_resource_update_latency_seconds_bucket[1h]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"}))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(ovnkube_controller_resource_delete_latency_seconds_bucket[1h]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Pod setup pipeline p99 (1h window)
panels.description: p99 per pod-setup stage over the last hour. Per-stage p99s are not additive, so the lines are not stacked.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (node) (rate(ovnkube_resource_retry_failures_total[$interval]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"}))
topk(10, ovn_northd_ovn_northd_loop_maximum * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"})
topk(10, ovn_northd_build_lflows_95th_percentile * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"})
topk(10, ovn_northd_ovnnb_db_run_95th_percentile * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"})
topk(10, ovn_northd_ovnsb_db_run_95th_percentile * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"})
topk(10, rate(ovn_controller_lflow_run[$interval]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"})
topk(10, ovn_db_db_size_bytes * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"})
topk(10, ovn_db_jsonrpc_server_sessions * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"})
topk(10, ovn_db_ovsdb_monitors * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"})
max by (node) (ovn_northd_nb_connection_status * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"})
max by (node) (ovn_northd_sb_connection_status * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"})
max by (node) (ovn_controller_southbound_database_connected * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"})
topk(10, sum by (node) (rate(ovnkube_master_libovsdb_disconnects_total[$interval]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) ovnk:ovn_pod_node:info{node=~"$node"}))
